by section 1753 of the Revised Statutes 
(5 U. S. C. 631), section 2 of the Civil

Retirement Act of May 29, 1936, as 
am ended, and in order to facilitate the 
employment of personnel by Federal 
agencies for service in foreign countries 
and beyond the continental limits of the 
United States, and to further the objec­
